summary: Processes a fixed array of four 12-byte slots (base a1+5628, stride 12). On every iteration decrements the float timer at a1+192 (offset 0xC0) via FloatFieldDecrement, then tests the current slot pointer with FloatThresholdCheck. A slot that passes the check is retained: if a compaction gap exists (retained counter v2 != iteration counter v3) the slot data is copied out with DataEntryCopy and the slot reset to empty with SmallStructInit_9a00, then the retained counter and compact write position advance by one slot. Called by sub_496E90 (00496e90) and SpriteTextureEnumeration (00498950).

local_names.v2: count of slots retained across the pass (compact destination index)
local_names.v5: compact write position, advanced by 12 per retained slot

operations.description: Runs four iterations over the 12-byte slot array starting at a1+5628; each iteration advances the slot pointer by 12 and the loop exits when the iteration counter reaches 4.
FloatFieldDecrement decrements the float timer at a1+192 (offset 0xC0) once per slot iteration, regardless of slot state.
FloatThresholdCheck(v1) tests the current 12-byte slot; its byte result selects whether the slot is retained.
When the threshold check passes and a compaction gap exists (v2 != v3), the slot data is copied out with DataEntryCopy(v1) and the slot is reset to empty with SmallStructInit_9a00(v1).
For each slot that passes the check, the retained counter v2 is incremented and the compact write position v5 is advanced by 12 bytes.
Returns the last value written to result: either the final FloatThresholdCheck outcome or the compact position plus 12, depending on whether the last iteration passed.
